doc.toml:
reflex = 1

description = """
Show the meetings of a day.
Each with its title and its time."""
not_for = ["moving a meeting", "rolling a release back"]
tags    = ["calendar"]
effect  = "read"
confirm = "Show the calendar for {day}?"
run     = "calendar.mts"

[args.day]
ask   = "Which day?"
vocab = "days"

[yields]
day = "date"

[examples]
"what is on my calendar tomorrow" = {}

ok.description:
Show the meetings of a day.
Each with its title and its time.
